items.title: Article: Post-Quantum Cryptography in Spring Boot: Four Patterns You Can Ship This Sprint
items.summary: There are four patterns that bring PQC into a Spring Boot fleet: encrypting payloads between services, locking down database fields, signing documents that need to hold up for decades, and moving service tokens off RS256. Along the way, we discuss why Harvest Now, Decrypt Later is already happening, and why none of this is production-safe until KMS or Vault is in place. By Pankaj Sharma

By Michael Redlich

Sätteri supports flexible JavaScript plugins and integrates various Markdown features natively. It maintains compatibility with the unified ecosystem while offering faster parsing and reduced dependencies. By Daniel Curtis
